payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies KAR as an end-to-end MRC model that integrates general knowledge to enhance its attention mechanisms.

claims.text: KAR is an end-to-end MRC model that uses general knowledge to assist its attention mechanisms.
KAR employs both mutual attention and self attention mechanisms, enhanced by knowledge extraction.
KAR is designed to be robust to noise and performs comparably to state-of-the-art MRC models.
